subject: NorthBridge pilot — exec approval request: credits + discount
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@northbridge.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NorthBridge pilot: request for extension, credits and first-year discount

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Quick follow up from our side: we reviewed the pilot telemetry and customer success feedback and NorthBridge is clearly accelerating usage (avg. token rate up ~3.2x week-over-week and two teams have moved to daily jobs). You mentioned budget timing concerns for an enterprise commit and asked if we could provide a bundled concession to bridge procurement.

Customer ask (high level):
- 60-day trial extension (to allow for model convergence across two additional workloads)
- $40,000 in complimentary credits applied to the pilot environment
- 15% off list price on the first-year committed consumption (applied at contract signature)

I've attached the pilot metrics and a promo model that shows ROI sensitivity. I'll need exec approval for the credits + discount; copying Marissa and Mina to help facilitate. If approved, we can attach an SOW addendum and a short-term PO.

Would you like me to run the final numbers with your procurement team (and a proposed signature window) or should we route straight to legal for contract language?

Best,
Dev
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: [NorthBridge_Pilot_Metrics_20270807.pdf]

From: Samir Shah <samir@northbridge.ai>

Dev — thanks for the fast follow-up. We appreciate the flexibility. The extension + credits would let us complete a compliance review and get legal the procurement window we need.

Two notes: 1) we can commit to a 12-month consumption forecast (we need final pricing to land the internal approval) and 2) we can provide a short customer reference call if needed.

If you can get the concessions through by next Wednesday, we should be able to sign the PO the following week.

—Samir
Head of ML Platforms, NorthBridge AI

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-07T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NorthBridge pilot: request for extension, credits and first-year discount

Marissa / Mina — forwarding Samir's reply. Short ask for exec review: customer is requesting the bundle described below. My read: strategic account, strong reference potential, likely $300–400k ARR year 1 if we lock pricing now.

Proposal (what I'm asking you to approve or modify):
- 60-day extension to the pilot environment
- $40k in trial credits (apply to pilot tenant; non-refundable; expires with pilot)
- 15% standard introductory discount off first-year committed usage (tiered pricing TBD in contract)

Impact and rationale:
- Net present cost to Redwood (approx): $40k credits + estimated $10–12k incremental unit cost to support extended pilot (GPU hours).
- Revenue upside: conservative forecast $320k ARR first year; 18–24 month retention expected given deep infra integration.
- Strategic value: enterprise reference + gateway into data-platform teams at two adjacent product units.

Attachments: NorthBridge_Promo_Model.xlsx (sensitivity + amortization).

Timing: customer requests decision by EOD next Wednesday to stay on procurement calendar. Please advise preferred concession level or if you'd like me to pursue a reduced ask.

Thanks,
Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-08T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NorthBridge pilot: request for extension, credits and first-year discount

Dev — quick questions before I take this to the exec queue:
1) Can you confirm the usage profile (p95 token consumption and expected run-rate after extension) — I don't want credits to be consumed in a single burst.
2) Can we tie the discount to a minimum committed $/month threshold? If they won't commit at all, I'd prefer we limit discount depth.
3) Are there any legal/regulatory wrinkles we need to be aware of for the reference (PII, redaction)?

If you can answer in one pager, I'll route for sign-off. Assuming minimal legal friction, I'd prefer to cap credits at $30k and offer a 12% first-year discount if they commit to a 12-month minimum of $25k/month. Thoughts?

—Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-08T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NorthBridge pilot: request for extension, credits and first-year discount

Marissa — answers inline and updated proposal below.

1) Usage profile: current p95 consumption is ~720k tokens/day for the pilot (two models). Projection with extension (if they onboard the two additional teams) is ~2.5–3.0M tokens/day, but ramp is linear over the 60 days (we're not seeing single-burst consumption in telemetry). I've attached a one-pager chart in the promo model.

2) Discount linkage: customer is willing to sign a 12-month commitment; they gave a conservative forecast of $25k/month run-rate post-commit. We'll require a $25k/month minimum to get the 12% discount.

3) Legal/regulatory: they will do an internal compliance review; no PII expected in current pilot datasets (synthetic and redacted). They asked for guidance on data retention policy and audit logging; CS has those artifacts ready.

Revised ask (per your cap):
- 45-day extension (we reduced from 60 to limit runway while still covering convergence)
- $30,000 in pilot credits (applied to the pilot tenant; expires at the end of extension)
- 12% first-year discount contingent on a 12-month minimum at $25k/month

Customer win condition: they sign a 12-month MRC PO within 30 days after approval. Expected year-1 commit: ~$300k ARR at the $25k/month threshold.

If you approve the revised terms I will update the offer doc and loop legal.

Thanks,
Dev
attachments: [NorthBridge_Promo_Model.xlsx]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-08-09T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: APPROVED: NorthBridge pilot concession (exec sign-off)

Team / Samir — after reviewing the model and the CS notes, I am approving the following one-time concession to close procurement:

Approved concessions:
- 45-day extension to the pilot environment
- $30,000 in pilot credits (non-transferable; expires at end of extension)
- 12% off first-year list pricing conditional on a signed 12-month minimum commitment at $25,000/month

Conditions:
- Customer PO or signed MRC must be received within 30 days of this approval.
- Legal will include a short SOW addendum for the credit application and a clause for audit logging access.
- CS to validate the non-PII nature of pilot datasets prior to credits being provisioned.

Dev — please update the offer doc, route to Legal for contract language, and attach the PO flow. Samir — once Legal has the SOW, please route your PO back to dev_patel@redwood.ai.

Exec sign-off: Marissa Cole, VP Sales, Redwood Inference
